# Record completion-grounded insight verdicts

Load when a request involves any of these terms: insights, reinforce, contradict, completion evidence.

## Step instructions

This step's Work details above already lists `linked insights`, each with its
`relationship` -- no separate fetch needed to find which ones are grounded. For
every entry whose relationship is `grounds`, judge whether this work's real
completion evidence confirms, contradicts, or leaves the cited basis inconclusive.
Need the insight's own claim text to judge it? `cwpilot insight search <id>` (id as
anchor) is a targeted, cheap lookup -- never re-fetch the whole WorkNode for this.
Record exactly one `insight_verdict` entry per grounded reference, including the
referenced id, the verdict, and the concrete completion evidence supporting it. If
there are no grounded references, record `insight_verdict: []`.

For each confirmed or contradicted reference, apply the corresponding
evidence-backed reinforcement or contradiction through the insight command,
using the WorkNode id and the verdict explanation. For a confirmation, run
`cwpilot insight reinforce <reference-id> --work <work-id> --why "<evidence>"`;
for a contradiction, use the same command with a negative, evidence-proportional
`--delta` (and `--contradicts <related-insight-id>` only when the verdict actually
establishes that typed relationship). Choose the delta from the strength of the
concrete completion evidence, rather than copying a constant boost. This is an
explicit orchestrator judgment, not a silent completion hook: do not call the
command for a reference whose verdict is inconclusive, and do not let a generic
completion path reinforce every linked insight automatically.

Record fact insight_verdicts_recorded=true once insight_verdict is set (even to
`[]`) -- the transition gate can't use exists() on insight_verdict alone, since an
empty list (the common, no-grounds case) and an unset fact are indistinguishable
to exists().

## Facts

- `insight_verdict`: One explicit completion verdict per aligned_facts entry with relationship grounds; each entry names the reference id, verdict, and concrete completion evidence. Use an empty list when no grounded references exist. Persisted in the generic StepEvidence record.
- `insight_verdicts_recorded`: Signal that insight_verdict has been explicitly set for this run (true even when the list is empty). Required because exists() treats an empty list as absent.
